categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of hard disk drive (HDD) components including voice coil motors (VCM), hard disk covers, external storage devices, HDD parts, read/write head stop parts, optical components, and medical device components. It also engages in precision plastic mold manufacturing, import/export trade, software and electronic information services, leasing, and intellectual property rights. The business is diversifying into optical components for projection equipment, biomedical products, and smart manufacturing automation.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies such as automated production lines, precision mold design, and assembly for HDD components. It employs magnetic recording technologies including PMR, SMR, and HAMR for high-capacity HDDs. The production process integrates AI, big data analytics, and optical inspection for quality control. The company also develops optical scanning mirrors and medical device parts with high precision and cleanliness standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major global HDD manufacturers such as Western Digital (WDC), Seagate, and Toshiba, serving the data storage industry. The company’s products are used in consumer electronics, enterprise servers, cloud storage, and surveillance systems. It also targets medical device manufacturers and projection equipment makers. The main markets are in Asia, the Americas, and Europe, with over 95% of sales in Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production and sales presence in Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, China, and the United States. It has subsidiaries and factories in Malaysia and China to serve international customers and optimize supply chain logistics. Sales are predominantly in Asia (over 95%), with growing markets in the Americas and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the HDD supply chain, manufacturing critical components such as voice coil motors and HDD covers. It sources raw materials like magnets, metal sheets, and plastics from upstream suppliers and supplies finished components to HDD assemblers and brand owners downstream. It also engages in some downstream activities through product assembly and integration for external storage devices.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include asset control, product mix optimization, quality and yield improvement, and diversification into new business areas such as optical components, biomedical products, and smart manufacturing automation. R&D focuses on enhancing manufacturing automation, AI-driven process control, high-precision optical scanning mirrors, and medical consumables. The company aims to expand non-HDD product lines and develop new storage interface technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of HDD components and related electronic parts. The company also earns income from medical device parts and optical components. It engages in contract manufacturing and may receive licensing or service fees related to intellectual property. The revenue is largely transactional based on sales volume to major HDD manufacturers and other industrial clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company’s main competitors in the voice coil motor segment include MMI, TDK, and Shinetzu, with TDK gradually exiting the market. Competitors are mostly Japanese and Singaporean firms with higher production costs or semi-automated processes. The company differentiates itself through automation, quality control, cost competitiveness, and diversified product offerings. It holds approximately 14% global market share in VCM components, positioning it as a significant player in the HDD component industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.5 billion, a 32% increase from the previous year, with net profit turning positive at NT$63.9 million compared to a loss in the prior year. The company’s assets total about NT$4.5 billion with equity around NT$2.7 billion. It has shown strong growth in revenue and profitability driven by HDD market recovery and increased shipments. R&D expenses represent about 3.7% of revenue, reflecting ongoing investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, automated production processes that improve yield and reduce costs, providing competitive pricing and reliable supply to major HDD manufacturers. Its integrated capabilities from mold design to assembly and strict quality management systems (ISO certifications) ensure product consistency. Diversification into optical and medical components and smart manufacturing solutions enhances its value proposition by offering customers innovative, multi-industry solutions beyond traditional HDD parts.
